text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан is now quite popular, and
the world
around her seems to be
changing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In response to the support of her fans,
she says
that she wants to win both the
Takarazuka Kinen
and the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
First up is the Takarazuka Kinen, where
her
rematch with Мэдзиро МакКуин is fast

approaching.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
